description: This file defines the Font class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling font-related properties, calculations for font metrics such as width and size, font file mappings, and constants related to font styling and charset. It also includes methods for loading TrueType font files and calculating column widths based on font and text.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents font properties, provides methods for font metrics calculations, font file mappings, and constants for font and charset definitions within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: setExtraFontArray
methods.description: Sets additional font mappings for font file retrieval.

methods.name: getExtraFontArray
methods.description: Retrieves additional font mappings for font file retrieval.

methods.name: setAutoSizeMethod
methods.description: Sets the method used for autosizing column widths ('approx' or 'exact').

methods.name: setTrueTypeFontPath
methods.description: Sets the directory path where TrueType font files (.ttf) are stored.

methods.name: getTrueTypeFontPath
methods.description: Gets the directory path where TrueType font files are stored.

methods.name: calculateColumnWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a column based on font and cell text, either approximately or exactly.

methods.name: getTextWidthPixelsExact
methods.description: Calculates the exact pixel width of a string in a given font and rotation angle.

methods.name: getTextWidthPixelsApprox
methods.description: Calculates an approximate pixel width of a string in a given font and rotation angle.

methods.name: fontSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts font size from points to pixels.

methods.name: inchSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts font size from inches to pixels.

methods.name: centimeterSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts font size from centimeters to pixels.

methods.name: getTrueTypeFontFileFromFont
methods.description: Retrieves the file path of the TrueType font file matching the font style, checks for font existence.

methods.name: getCharsetFromFontName
methods.description: Returns charset code associated with the font name.

methods.name: getDefaultColumnWidthByFont
methods.description: Returns the default column width for a given font in pixels or OOXML units.

methods.name: getDefaultRowHeightByFont
methods.description: Returns the default row height for a given font in points.
